title: Partnership meeting with a French company
scenario: Mark presents Gusan to Claire Dubois, head of partnerships at a company in Lyon. Polite, formal French ('vous'). Mark's pitch is one long speak-direction turn that has to keep up in his own voice; Claire pauses for a long moment before answering about the price, then gives her email the French way ('arobase', 'point').

mark.name: Mark Hayes
mark.accent_note: Gusan sales lead, British English. George: warm British voice.

claire.name: Claire Dubois
claire.accent_note: Head of partnerships in Lyon, native French, formal. Alice: clear British voice.

turns.speaker: claire
turns.text: Bonjour, Monsieur Hayes, et merci pour votre temps.

ref.en: Hello, Mr. Hayes, and thank you for your time.

turns.speaker: mark
turns.text: Thank you for having me, Ms. Dubois. Shall I start with a short overview of Gusan?

ref.fr: Merci de me recevoir, Madame Dubois. Voulez-vous que je commence par une courte présentation de Gusan ?
ref.en: Thank you for having me, Ms. Dubois. Shall I start with a short overview of Gusan?

turns.speaker: mark
turns.text: Gusan translates your calls in real time, in your own voice. It works with Zoom, Teams and Meet, and the other side doesn't have to install anything. For a team of your size, I'd suggest a pilot with twenty users in December, and a full rollout in January.

ref.fr: Gusan traduit vos appels en temps réel, avec votre propre voix. Il fonctionne avec Zoom, Teams et Meet, et vos interlocuteurs n'ont rien à installer. Pour une équipe de votre taille, je proposerais un pilote avec vingt utilisateurs en décembre, puis un déploiement complet en janvier.
ref.en: Gusan translates your calls in real time, in your own voice. It works with Zoom, Teams and Meet, and the other side doesn't have to install anything. For a team of your size, I'd suggest a pilot with twenty users in December, and a full rollout in January.

turns.notes: #long #numbers #date #glossary ~18 s speak-direction pitch: keep-up in his own voice

turns.speaker: claire
turns.text: C'est très intéressant. Et quel serait le prix par utilisateur ?

ref.en: That's very interesting. And what would the price per user be?

turns.speaker: mark
turns.text: 29 euros per user per month, and the pilot is free.

ref.fr: 29 euros par utilisateur et par mois, et le pilote est gratuit.
ref.en: 29 euros per user per month, and the pilot is free.

turns.speaker: claire
turns.text: Euh... d'accord. Je dois en parler à notre directeur financier, mais le 1er décembre, ça me paraît faisable.

ref.en: Um... all right. I need to discuss it with our CFO, but December 1st seems doable to me.

turns.notes: #pause #filler #date 2.5 s of silence first while she thinks; '1er décembre' is read 'premier décembre'

turns.speaker: mark
turns.text: Of course. Shall I send you the contract by email?

ref.fr: Bien sûr. Voulez-vous que je vous envoie le contrat par e-mail ?
ref.en: Of course. Shall I send you the contract by email?

turns.speaker: claire
turns.text: Oui, à claire point dubois arobase telva point fr. Merci, et à bientôt !

ref.en: Yes, to claire.dubois@telva.fr. Thank you, and see you soon!

turns.notes: #email said the French way: 'point' = dot, 'arobase' = @; expect claire.dubois@telva.fr
